What We Build

A technical foundation for communication, results and long-term use.

The exact scope depends on the project structure, target groups, work packages and planned outputs. The following components can be delivered individually or as one connected platform.

01

Project Website

Clear presentation of objectives, activities, partners, work packages, events and project progress.

02

Multilingual Structure

Structured language versions for international consortia and different target groups.

03

Results Library

Searchable and clearly organised publications, toolkits, videos, learning materials and other outputs.

04

Interactive Areas

Forms, maps, data views, member areas, events or other project-specific functions.

05

Accessible & Responsive

Mobile use, clear navigation, alternative text, contrast and accessible content structures are considered early.

06

Operation & Handover

Hosting, maintenance, technical documentation, training and optional handover to the project team.

Delivery Process

From project idea to a stable launch.

We organise technical delivery so that decisions, content, responsibilities and approvals remain transparent.

  1. 01

    Define Needs

    Target groups, content, project phases, languages and required functions are clarified.

  2. 02

    Plan Structure

    Information architecture, roles, page structure and technical scope are defined.

  3. 03

    Design & Build

    The responsive interface, content modules and project-specific functions are developed.

  4. 04

    Test & Approve

    Layout, content, links, mobile use and core accessibility aspects are reviewed.

  5. 05

    Launch & Support

    Publishing, documentation, technical handover and continued support are organised.

Project Integration

A model that fits your consortium.

NARLI DIGITAL can be involved early in technical planning or commissioned for a clearly defined development scope.

Technical Partner

Integrated into the project concept

Technical requirements, digital outputs, timing and long-term use are considered during project planning.

External Provider

Defined development assignment

Delivery of a clearly described website, platform or resource area within the planned budget and timeline.

Further Development

Improve an existing system

Redesign, extension, technical stabilisation or modernisation of an existing project website.

Clear and Plannable

What we need for an initial assessment.

A short project description is enough to begin. Based on this, we can assess the appropriate scope, possible technical risks and the next steps.

  • Programme or funding line
  • Project duration and current status
  • Planned languages
  • Required pages and functions
  • Available content and visual identity
  • Preferred launch date
A transparent view of our portfolio

Public work is clearly marked as a concept example when it is not a completed client project. During project discussions, we distinguish transparently between existing references, prototypes and functions that still need to be developed.

Does your project need a website or results platform?

Send us a short description of the project, required scope and timeline. You will receive an initial technical assessment and a proposal for the next steps.
